description: The Uniform Coordinator manages GNGRLL's uniform program end to end: sampling and pricing with vendors (Boombah, Main Street Graphics, Dick's/Gilbert), collecting sizes, placing jersey and hat orders against the annual budget, and coordinating distribution to coaches and teams. They enforce recurring calendar rules such as the customized-jersey registration deadline and vendor order cutoffs, run the pre-season sizing event, and track delivery so uniforms arrive ahead of picture day and opening games. The role also handles special orders for All-Star, Junior, and Senior teams and maintains uniform vendor/pricing research as an ongoing project.

calendar.title: Fall uniform sampling and pricing kickoff
calendar.description: Begin gathering vendor samples and pricing for the coming season (Boombah, Main Street Graphics, Dick's), including girl's-cut softball options, and note jersey ordering deadlines for board discussion.

calendar.title: Early-signup jersey deadline planning
calendar.description: Review uniform sampling and pricing and confirm the early-signup custom-uniform incentive and its jersey deadline so registration messaging can promote it.

calendar.title: Uniform vendor quotes and jersey layout due
calendar.description: Finalize vendor quotes, sponsor-on-front jersey layout, girl's-cut softball fit, and the customized-jersey deadline for board review ahead of ordering.

calendar.title: Early-signup custom jersey deadline (Feb 15)
calendar.description: Early-signup incentive cutoff for customized uniforms; players registered by this date qualify for a personalized jersey.

calendar.title: Uniform purchase decision at board meeting
calendar.description: Present final vendor pick, team sizes and extras, and per-player budget for a spending motion; confirm the order can hit the vendor deadline.

calendar.title: Customized jersey registration deadline (3/14)
calendar.description: Final registration deadline to receive a customized jersey - no exceptions. Teams finalized by this date; players registering after receive a generic backup jersey.

calendar.title: Boombah order deadline
calendar.description: Submit the AAA-and-above Boombah uniform order plus Gilbert hats by the vendor cutoff (around late March).

calendar.title: Uniform sizing event
calendar.description: Host the pre-order sizing event with jersey and pant samples for players to try on; last chance to correct fit before final order adjustments go in.

calendar.title: Uniform delivery tracking begins
calendar.description: Track incoming uniform shipments from vendors and coordinate timing with picture day so teams have uniforms before photos and opening games.

calendar.title: Coach uniform pickup window
calendar.description: Uniforms are ready for coaches or one team representative to collect and distribute; parents do not pick up individually. After-hours access via storage code.

calendar.title: All-Star uniform ordering
calendar.description: Order All-Star team jerseys and uniforms (about $50/player) once rosters are voted, following per-player budget approvals.

calendar.title: Junior/Senior summer uniform procurement
calendar.description: Procure Junior and Senior uniforms for advancing and summer-ball teams as those rosters are set.

calendar.title: Uniform vendor/pricing research review
calendar.description: Ongoing project: research uniform vendors and pricing options to inform next season's sampling and ordering decisions.

tasks.title: Request fall vendor samples and pricing
tasks.description: Reach out to Boombah, Main Street Graphics, and Dick's for current-season samples and price sheets, including girl's-cut softball jerseys, and outline jersey ordering deadlines.

tasks.title: Confirm early-signup jersey incentive terms
tasks.description: Set the early-signup custom-uniform incentive and its Feb 15 deadline, and hand the details to registration/LIO for promotion.

tasks.title: Compile vendor quotes and jersey layout
tasks.description: Assemble final vendor quotes, sponsor-on-front layout mockups, and per-division pricing (e.g. $28.50/set for TB/CP/AA and $50/player Boombah + Gilbert hats for AAA and up) for board review.

tasks.title: Present uniform purchase motion to the board
tasks.description: Bring the recommended vendor, team sizes and extras, and per-player budget to the board for a spending motion so the order can be placed on time.

tasks.title: Enforce customized-jersey deadline and finalize order
tasks.description: Lock the 3/14 customized-jersey registration deadline, reconcile personalized vs. generic backup jerseys, and finalize team rosters for the order.

tasks.title: Submit Boombah and hat orders
tasks.description: Place the AAA-and-above Boombah order and Gilbert/hat order by the vendor cutoff; confirm coach adult-hat allotment per team.

tasks.title: Run the uniform sizing event
tasks.description: Send the sizing-event announcement, bring jersey and pant size samples, collect fit corrections, and submit final order adjustments by the deadline.

tasks.title: Track uniform delivery against picture day
tasks.description: Monitor vendor shipments and coordinate delivery timing with information_officer's picture/photo day so uniforms arrive first.

tasks.title: Coordinate coach uniform pickup and distribution
tasks.description: Send the coach-pickup notice with day, time, and location; instruct one representative per team (not individual parents); provide storage access code; and send the youth-vs-adult hat clarification with coach adult-hat counts.

tasks.title: Order All-Star uniforms
tasks.description: Once All-Star rosters are voted, order team jerseys/uniforms at about $50/player per the approved per-player budget.

tasks.title: Procure Junior/Senior summer uniforms
tasks.description: Order uniforms for Junior, Senior, and summer/tournament teams as advancing rosters are confirmed.

tasks.title: Update uniform vendor and pricing research
tasks.description: Refresh the running uniform vendor/pricing research notes with this season's results to inform next year's sampling and ordering.
